launch.note: interactive `claude` for the operator's live CONDUCTOR chat pane; provider flags come from the registered adapter and the shell uses the shared supervised pane-1 lifecycle.

succession.note: kill the conductor mid-run → Resume → Select a backend → reconstruct zero-loss (SuccessionManager) → restore the operator selection (restore_operator_selection).

executing.note: per-node model 'fable-5' (accepted-id unverified until live smoke)

transport_contract: UserPromptSubmit asks the supervisor process to admit the exact pending payload
PreToolUse and PermissionRequest ask the supervisor process for deny decisions
Stop/StopFailure/SessionEnd are recorded as observations and never disarm
only Electron main's own operator-keyboard observation (or the observed process exit) ends an admitted voice turn
transport loss blocks or denies fail-closed
authority_boundary.transport_limit: the ticket pins transport bytes/settings but cannot claim a listening supervisor; Electron main upgrades the runtime boundary only after its authenticated loopback authority service is listening and injected into the supervised child

containment.bound_by: shell supervised spawn — SessionManager.spawn refuses without an admitted node (IpcSupervisor.admit over the verified control-plane channel), reports the lifecycle, and kills every session on loss
containment.owed_to: U25 (pid→job-object handoff needs the IPC write op; U78(b)-(d) → 17D)
containment.note: authorization + counted terminal + an applied per-turn permission profile; supervisor session registration, workspace binding and credential scrubbing are enforced by the shell's supervised spawn. OS job-object containment remains the Node Runtime's U25 boundary.
